title: 真実の沈黙：声なき街の記録者
author: 霧島 慧

en.title: Silence of Truth: The Recorder of the Silent City
en.premise: In a city where every citizen is implanted with a nanomachine that forbids lying, words must always be precise, and falsehoods carry the weight of social death. A young record keeper stumbles upon an anonymous "lost letter" among the waste, a message filled with inexplicable, contradictory emotions that defy logic. As he follows the deadly "blank" hidden within a world painted with perfect truth, he uncovers a hidden fracture in the façade of utopia.

zh.title: 真相的沉默：无声之城的记录者
zh.premise: 在一座每位市民都被植入禁止说谎的纳米机器的城市里，言语必须始终精准，虚假言论意味着社会死亡。年轻的记录官在废弃物中偶然发现一封匿名的“失落信件”，其中记录着逻辑无法解释、充满矛盾的情感。追踪隐藏在完美真相中的致命“空白”，他开始揭开乌托邦表象下的裂痕。
